races.paceDynamic: Roc Dino will control this race from the front with Paul Townend able to dictate terms at his own speed. Speculateur and Hawk's Rock are the only other horses likely to race prominently, but neither has shown the inclination to truly press a leader. With most of the field preferring to sit back and wait, including hold-up horses like Brohatna, Loch Cuan and Evangelic, Roc Dino faces minimal early pressure. This pace setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop in the packed midfield and rear divisions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Roc Dino Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Roc Dino jumps cleanly and Paul Townend judges the pace correctly from the front
scenarios.body: The Mullins horse can string out the field over this staying trip and prove too strong for the closers. His two seconds at this level show he has the class edge over most of these.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Speculateur or Hawk's Rock can apply sustained pressure to Roc Dino throughout
scenarios.body: The pace will become more genuine and set up the race for horses that can travel prominently without leading. Elliott's Speculateur has been consistent at this level and gets weight relief.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Evangelic or Loch Cuan can use their finishing kicks. However, traffic problems are likely given the small field size and lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites disappoint or make jumping errors at crucial stages
scenarios.body: Union Boy represents an in-form yard making his hurdles debut, while Jenny's Bar gets significant weight relief. The pace setup doesn't favour them but class can be overrated in maidens.

races.paceDynamic: Kalsman is the sole confirmed front runner in this 18-runner field and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a controlled gallop from the outset. The prominent runners like Loup De Tallane, Stonecarthy and Annarubyrose will track just behind but lack the natural pace to challenge early. With 13 hold-up horses in the field including the talented Joya Del Mar and Bearami Creek, the race will develop into a cavalry charge from the back straight as the hold-up brigade make their moves. This tactical setup heavily favours the hold-up horses who can exploit the modest early pace and time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Kalsman dictating
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader sets up perfect conditions for the closers to unleash devastating late runs. Quality hold-up performers like Joya Del Mar and Bearami Creek can pick off the early leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Kalsman Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Kalsman maintains his rhythm and the closers fail to coordinate their challenges effectively
scenarios.body: The front runner's class tells as he repels the late charges, particularly if some hold-up horses get caught in traffic. His recent winning form suggests he can sustain the gallop better than his pursuers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can stay closer to Kalsman and kick before the hold-up horses engage
scenarios.body: Loup De Tallane or Stonecarthy could exploit their forward position to strike in the final two furlongs before the back markers arrive. Their tactical advantage negates the closers' superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Kalsman stops suddenly and no horse takes up the running early enough
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with horses queuing up behind a crawling pace, leading to a sprint finish that suits horses with natural speed regardless of position. This chaotic scenario opens the door for unconsidered runners.

watchPoints.text: Kalsman's jumping under pressure - any mistake when the closers arrive could end his bid immediately
Traffic problems developing for the hold-up horses as 13 need to find room simultaneously in the straight
Joya Del Mar's position turning for home as she needs clear running to unleash her proven finishing kick
Weather conditions affecting the going further as multiple reports show potential for deterioration
The prominent runners' early positioning as they must stay close enough to Kalsman without over-racing

races.paceDynamic: Nevermindestranger will take this field along at a sustainable gallop from the front, with Lemmy Caution, Rare Times, and Echinacea likely to track close behind in the early stages. The pace should be even rather than frantic given the maiden hurdle nature and lack of confirmed front-runners beyond Nevermindestranger. In the final half-mile, the race will develop into a staying test where horses need to find a sustained finish rather than a sharp turn of foot. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina who can position close to the pace and grind out the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Grind
scenarios.trigger: If Nevermindestranger sets an even gallop without serious pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina where horses tracking the pace can mount sustained challenges from the two-furlong pole. Those positioned prominently with staying power will have the tactical advantage over hold-up horses who need the gaps to appear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Nevermindestranger gets an uncontested lead and the pace proves too slow for closers to make up ground
scenarios.body: The veteran will use his experience to dictate terms and prove too tough to peg back in the final furlong when the pace lifts. His stamina and tactical speed from the front will be decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the final two furlongs become a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses with a turn of foot will benefit from the change of pace and ability to produce their best work late. The race will suit those who can quicken rather than purely stay.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Nevermindestranger goes too fast early or gets pressured into a speed duel by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace will become unsustainable and cause the leaders to weaken dramatically, opening the door for patient hold-up horses to sweep through late. Fresh legs will triumph over tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Nevermindestranger's fitness after 588-day layoff could see him weaken dramatically if the pace becomes searching in the final two furlongs.
Flying Ace and Endless Talking both need the pace to develop into a sprint finish to showcase their hold-up style effectively against this tactical field.
The 7lb claiming riders on Betty's Glen, Shanliss Tricks, Dorie Miller, and Nevermindestranger provide significant weight advantages that could prove decisive in a tight finish.
Echinacea's return from a fall needs monitoring for any signs of lost confidence or ability over the obstacles.
Lemmy Caution's prominent style and consistent form make him the most reliable option if positioned close to the pace throughout.

races.paceDynamic: Camlin Park will take the field along as the sole committed front runner, setting a manageable tempo without pressure from other early pace. The large field of 14 runners will create a strung-out affair with most horses held up in the rear, making forward positions at a premium. With limited pace pressure early, the race will develop into a cavalry charge from the back straight where positioning becomes crucial. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical pace who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Camlin Park maintains his lead without serious early challenge
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too steady for the back markers to make up ground, while those racing prominently behind the leader get first run. Camlin Park's control of tempo neutralizes the superior ratings of the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway as prominent runners challenge Camlin Park
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and creates gaps for those racing in forward positions. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do as the race develops into a staying test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horror Show
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems develop in the straight with 14 runners bunching up
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get stopped in their tracks or forced wide, allowing a horse with clear passage to capitalize. The race becomes a lottery based on luck in running rather than merit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very steady and the field remains tightly bunched turning in
scenarios.body: Superior class tells as the highest-rated hold-up horses get perfect splits through the field. The race becomes a pure stamina test where ratings matter most.

watchPoints.text: Camlin Park's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could compromise his front-running advantage and change the entire race dynamic
Traffic problems in the home straight with 14 runners - several hold-up horses including A Snow White Park and Katherine could get badly hampered
Mercurial Sea's position turning for home - if he's close enough to the leaders he could have the perfect tactical advantage
Small Bucks and Frontier Rose for their usual fading pattern - both have shown tendency to weaken in the final furlong
Sea Of Doubt's fitness after 218-day break - early positioning will indicate whether he's ready to fire fresh

races.paceDynamic: Finnians Row looks the only genuine pace-setter in this field, with most others content to settle and come late. The prominent runners Bocelli's Voice and Katzoff may track early, but this shapes as a pedestrian gallop with the front-runner getting his own way through the early stages. With so many hold-up horses including Tsavo Park, Struck Oil, Jouster, and the others waiting to pounce, the race will develop into a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters most. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent/early positioned runners who can avoid traffic problems in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Finnians Row establishes an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old gets first run on his rivals and has enough stamina reserves to resist the late challengers. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against a horse who has controlled the race from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rush Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes a pure sprint finish from the last fence
scenarios.body: The quality hold-up horses led by Tsavo Park and Struck Oil show their class in a driving finish. Prominent runners get swamped by the superior finishing kicks of the patient riders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a steady gallop with tactical positioning crucial
scenarios.body: Horses that settle in the middle of the pack get the perfect trip and can strike at the right moment. The pace is honest enough to set up their run but not so strong that they're out of contention.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Finnians Row goes too slow early and creates a messy, stop-start race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace leads to bunching and interference problems that compromise several chances. The winner emerges from the chaos more by luck than judgment as jockeyship becomes paramount.

races.paceDynamic: Difficult Decision will lead from the front with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early, creating a sustainable gallop over this staying trip. The prominent runners Dinoland, Person Of Interest, and My Cullen will sit tracking in behind, while the large hold-up contingent including Hardy Diamond, Shantou Show, and My Good Pal will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. With only one natural leader and a large field of hold-up horses, this sets up perfectly for the prominent trackers who can control their position and have first run on the leader, making the prominent/handy style the tactical profile to follow.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest but not excessive with Difficult Decision leading
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get the perfect trip tracking the lone leader and can strike with the first move before the hold-up horses get organized. Dinoland and Person Of Interest are ideally placed to capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If Difficult Decision goes too fast early or the prominent horses engage too soon
scenarios.body: The strong pace sets up a classic finish for the hold-up brigade with Hardy Diamond and Shantou Show finding their rhythm late. My Good Pal could also benefit from the collapse up front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Frontrunner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Difficult Decision gets an easy lead and the field allows him to dictate throughout
scenarios.body: The 13-year-old veteran uses his experience to steal the race with tactical speed and stamina. The hold-up horses leave their run too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or the favorites disappoint tactically
scenarios.body: The chaos allows a lesser-fancied runner to pick up the pieces when the market leaders cancel each other out. Mastermind's recent win shows he's in form.
